source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines a simplex-constrained population optimizer and proves uniform coverage for a joint confidence set for a weight and its fixed functional under Assumption 3.2.

The paper decomposes uncertainty into synthetic-control weight-estimation error and unobservable post-treatment prediction error, with an appendix extension to stationary weakly dependent time series.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Definition 1 restricts the finite-sample class to bands whose induced confidence set is determined by a nonrandom set; Theorem 2 gives approximation conditions for a generic objective, while the displayed low-level sufficient-condition discussion is specifically for weighted area.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper's simulation result concerns convergence of approximated minimax expected-size confidence-region risk over its finite-prior Monte Carlo formulation.
The published article develops finite-sample optimal confidence intervals and sharp efficiency bounds for linear functionals over convex regression-function classes under normal errors.
The paper establishes sparse predictor-selection consistency and a faster predictor-match mean-squared-error rate in a linear factor-model framework.
The work studies minimax expected-measure confidence sets for restricted location parameters, rather than maximum width of a simultaneous curve band.

Report a second low-dimensional KKT-cell instance with certified primal--dual bounds, complementary to the hinge, to demonstrate that the finite program handles more than the scalar reduction.
